notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation focused on Dedicated capacity for low-latency voyage planning and manifest matching. Primary ask: predictable throughput for peak booking windows and strict p95 latency SLOs for chat/assistant flows.

Key contacts:
- CTO: Marco Alvarez (technical owner)
- Head of ML Ops: Cara Liu (internal POC)
- Procurement: Lisa Gomez

Workload profile and requirements (from workshop 2026-02-18):
- Workloads: reranking of manifests (batch + realtime), agent chat for operations, embeddings-backed search for historical manifests, summarization of voyage logs.
- Baseline steady-state: 35 QPS average across inference endpoints (mostly reranking + embeddings lookups).
- Typical token profile: 40 tokens/request for rerank, 120 tokens/request for chat summaries, 8-16 tokens/embedding vector call.
- Steady-state token/sec: ~1,400 tokens/sec sustained (estimate).
- Peak windows: up to 220 QPS sustained for 8-10 minute booking surges (regional peak periods).
- Peak token/sec: up to ~18,000 tokens/sec during surges when chat + rerank overlap.
- Target latency SLOs: p95 <= 200ms for reranking endpoints, p95 <= 300ms for chat assistant (streaming acceptable for >300ms).
- Throughput guarantee ask: reserved throughput to handle 220 QPS with p95 SLOs during peak, plus autoscale/burst policy for 10% overflow.

Sizing workshop outcomes and notes:
- Redwood SE ran preliminary sizing using their benchmarking profile (gpt-like 7B quantized runtime). Rough sizing suggests 6x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved for steady + buffer, with additional 2x GPUs as burst pool (dedicated) to meet peak with concurrency tuning.
- Suggestion: split endpoint routing across two model variants (fast-quantized reranker + higher-quality chat model) to reduce effective token/sec; fallback route to cheaper variant if burst pool is exhausted.
- Caching: strong opportunity for prefix and KV caching for repeated manifest reranks (expected 15-20% token savings).
- Batching policy: recommend continuous batching with 25-50ms batching window for reranker to tradeoff p95 and throughput.

POC plan (agreed):
- 72-hour dedicated POC: provision 8 GPU nodes in Redwood Dedicated pool with VPC peering. Run synthetic and replay workloads from last quarter to capture p50/p95/p99 latency and token throughput. Capture cost per 1M tokens.
- Security POC: run through SSO and KMS integration (customer will provide test KMS in staging).
- Deliverables: benchmark report, suggested reserved capacity profile, SLA draft (latency & throughput SLAs), cost model + savings if caching & batching tuned.
